The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `5672` (see `RabbitMqBuilder.RabbitMqPort`)
- Environment variable: `RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER=rabbitmq` (see `RabbitMqBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS=rabbitmq` (see `RabbitMqBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Server startup complete` is logged.
